name: step-read
description: read fetches an attribute field and a boolean state field into named variables.
yaml:
- launchApp
- read:
    selector: { id: "quantity_field" }
    field: value
    as: quantity
- read:
    selector: { id: "terms_checkbox" }
    field: checked
    as: accepted
- read:
    selector: { id: "quantity_field" }
    as: defaultedField
